composition_subtypes.role: Iterates over descending skill list, greedily grouping programmers into teams based on condition c*s[i]>=x.

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy team formation: sort skills descending, iterate, and group consecutive programmers into teams when team size * min skill >= x.
payload.rationale: The solution is primarily a greedy algorithm; sorting is only preprocessing to enable greedy scanning. No coordination of multiple distinct algorithmic families.
